title: swatplus-bmi: stepping the SWAT+ watershed model one day at a time through the Basic Model Interface
description:
swatplus-bmi runs SWAT+ one day at a time under outside control, through the Basic Model Interface (BMI 2.0). A small patch adds an exchange mode to SWAT+, off by default, in which SWAT+ pauses before each day; a Python wrapper reads state (channel flow, aquifer storage, depth to water, recharge) and sets fluxes for the next day (point source flow, water allocation demand). Stepped this way, SWAT+'s output is byte-for-byte identical to an unpatched run. Paused runs can be branched (fork) or saved and loaded, with the state serializer generated from SWAT+'s module declarations for each release.

Licenses: the exchange mode and patched SWAT+ are under the GNU LGPL 2.1 (the license of SWAT+); the Python wrapper and everything else are under the BSD 3-Clause license.
